file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

README.md outlines running locally with MinIO in step 2 but does not mention `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000`. We should add instructions to set `S3_ENDPOINT` (and optionally create the bucket) in the local setup steps in README.md when using MinIO.
